title: Separate common/degree edge-change effects from pair-specific interactions

target_design.cutoff_rule: For target i, construct every state and rank from draws[:i], freeze rankings, then read draw i.

hypothesis: The zero-row-sum pair-specific residual of the symmetric edge-change matrix may carry incremental information beyond common/degree main effects and node-only inertia.

decomposition.mu: sum(E)/(n*(n-1)) over all ordered off-diagonal entries.
invariants: every E_pair row sum is zero to 1e-10
E_main and E_pair are Frobenius-orthogonal to numerical tolerance

frozen_operator.node_only: signed cosine(current node delta, previous node delta), EWMA20 decay 0.80; reversion multiplier.

selection: No candidate or parameter selection. PAIR_INTERACTION is the predeclared focal operator. Discovery and Validation are reported chronologically; historical Blind OOS is evaluated once and remains exploratory.

statistics.exact_null: 45 tests: 5 models x 3 chronological splits x Top5/Top10/Top20; exact Hypergeometric(40,k,5) upper-tail null and one global Holm family.
statistics.paired: 32 tests: Validation and historical Blind OOS x four controls (FULL_EDGE, DEGREE_MAIN, NODE_ONLY, EQUAL42) x Top5/Top10/Top20/mean actual rank; circular moving-block bootstrap length 20, 2,000 replicates, one global Holm family.
statistics.primary_gate: On historical Blind OOS, PAIR_INTERACTION must exceed DEGREE_MAIN Top20 by at least 0.10 hits/target, paired block-bootstrap CI lower bound >0, paired Holm p<0.05, and exact-null Holm p<0.05. The same direction and inferential criteria must hold versus EQUAL42; this historical slice is exploratory and cannot establish prospective confirmation.

safeguards: Archive byte identity pinned by Git blob SHA-1; no archive rewrite after registration.
Every target state uses draws[:i]; no current or future outcome is used to form the ranking.
All four transfer operators use fixed alpha/window/decay; no Validation or Blind OOS tuning.
The decomposition is deterministic and tested for exact reconstruction, symmetry, zero diagonal and zero residual row sums.
All five rankings are frozen before reading the target quintet.
One global Holm family for exact-null tests and one global Holm family for paired tests.
Moving-block bootstrap is reported separately because exact hypergeometric tests assume independent target draws.
Historical Blind OOS is already exposed in earlier SONAR experiments; it is exploratory, not virgin holdout.
Pair graph is a statistical co-occurrence descriptor, not physical coupling or proof of causality.
No immutable freeze modification, no prospective shadow insertion, no model promotion and no automatic merge.
